mission_chirho.statement_chirho: Iron out all code paths that are not Haskell-compatible until Haskelujah is a drop-in replacement for GHC on real programs and real Hackage packages — and improve on GHC (diagnostics, memory safety, portability, multi-backend, build speed) without ever breaking the drop-in contract.
drop_in_contract_chirho: Programs GHC 9.6/Haskell2010+common-extensions accepts must compile and produce the same observable behavior (stdout, exit codes, laziness-visible semantics).
Prelude/base semantics match GHC (Num defaulting, div/mod flooring, laziness, exceptions) — verified against the vendored GHC testsuite in ghc-tests-chirho/.
Cabal/Hackage packages are the end target (lens is the named milestone); package smoke set: transformers, mtl, parsec.
Deviations from GHC are explicit, documented, and never silent (truth-in-public).
improvements_allowed_chirho: Better structured diagnostics with fix suggestions
Memory-safe Rust runtime; no segfault-class bugs
First-class Wasm + multi-backend (LLVM primary, Cranelift/JVM/BEAM tracked)
Faster incremental builds; cleaner module-interface design (no GHC .hi coupling)
Rule: an improvement may never change the observable semantics of an accepted program except behind an explicit flag.

invariants_chirho.rule_chirho: User-level >>= / >> / return / pure may be positively dispatched to a $prim_* body ONLY when the type key is PROVEN (constructor-shaped/annotated/locally-keyed — a wrong positive key is worse than none: it runs another monad's body on an IO value). Every unresolved case must survive the dict pass NAME-PRESERVED (rebuild_preserved_method_app_chirho — the generic dict rewrite turned unresolved methods into bodyless-selector literal-0# crashes) and reach STG lowering under its original name (is_io_primop_chirho + primop_name_to_kind_chirho). HISTORY CORRECTION: the pre-b5203335 'byte-identical fallback' claim held at the LOWERING level only — the machine's BindIOChirho/ThenIOChirho were Int-0 STUBS (old eval_chirho.rs ~1898; IO do-blocks worked only because case/let forcing executed effects); b5203335 gave them real semantics (BindIO applies the continuation via apply_fn_to_value_chirho; ThenIO returns the second value). bindIO#/thenIO#/returnIO# stay primops forever (GPT WI-D).
One builder, -j2, no parallel workspace builds, prebuilt binary for scouting. Violations risk OOMing the shared machine (direct L.J. instruction).
Scoreboards, README claims, and broker reports state real pass/fail counts from fresh runs, never cached optimism and never invented numbers.

deep_strategy_chirho.context_chirho: L.J. directive 2026-07-01: 'do a whole sweep over the group of failing tests, find a deep strategy to resolve it all.' The sweep (73 driver reds + GHC-suite gap + probe) shows the failures are NOT dozens of independent bugs — they cluster under four architectural pillars. Work items reference their pillar; when in doubt, invest in the pillar, not the symptom.

pillars_chirho.thesis_chirho: Every class-method use resolves through a single decision ladder: (1) concrete type key -> $prim_Class_method_Type body; (2) built instance dict -> $sel_Class_method $dClass_Type; (3) in-scope dict param (polymorphic caller) -> selector on the param; (4) name-preserving fallback (IO primops / legacy). do-notation desugars to real >>= / >> chains so it rides the same ladder. Special-case interceptors (fmap's) become the generic HK dispatch and retire as bodies/dicts complete.
pillars_chirho.resolves_chirho: maybe-do, either/list/Maybe explicit binds, >> on non-IO monads, monad-transformer failures (~12), most 'prints 0' wrong-value reds, Alternative/MonadPlus gaps

pillars_chirho.thesis_chirho: The typechecker knows result types the Core rewrite cannot see. Thread inferred/annotated types (TyApp nodes, binding signatures, do-block element types) into the dict pass so return-position polymorphism (return/pure/mempty/fromInteger defaulting) dispatches. This is the difference between argument-shape dispatch (done) and real evidence elaboration (GHC's model).
pillars_chirho.resolves_chirho: pure 7 :: Either, signature-driven returns, numeric literal defaulting reds, a large slice of typecheck/should_compile inference failures, Data.Map inference cluster (imported polymorphic values need their iface types respected in Core)

pillars_chirho.thesis_chirho: Thunk infrastructure exists; forcing is not applied at every use site. Define the canonical force points (primop args, case scrutinees, function position, seq) in ONE helper and call it everywhere, so interpreter semantics match GHC and compiled backends inherit a single spec. Thunk entry must update the heap node in-place to avoid duplicate evaluation (gpt scaffold note).
pillars_chirho.resolves_chirho: lazy-evaluation reds, undefined/bottom-tolerance failures, foldl'/deepseq semantics, prerequisite for backend parity

pillars_chirho.thesis_chirho: Once pillars 1-3 hold, the remaining gap is enumerable: per-type instance completion by recipe, GHC-suite buckets by feature, backend closures/IO/GC by roadmap. These parallelize across agents because each item is independent and gated.
pillars_chirho.resolves_chirho: remaining driver reds, typecheck suite to >95%, native backend to self-hosting

corrections_folded_chirho: Monadic dispatch: 29d9f262 strict-key hardening already landed; remaining issue is IO primop names in argument position and signature-driven dispatch, not another blind key widening.

Pure/return: lookup_name_id_chirho is not a body-backed existence check because dangling $prim_*_IO names exist; future dispatch must verify generated bodies, and must gate by RHS shape to avoid rewriting embedded returns such as [IO Int].
Dict matrix: First/Last wrap Maybe, not bare values; Foldable/Traversable/Dual/contextual methods need evidence threading and are not mechanical wave-A fodder.
Data.Map cluster: not Data.Map imports primarily; it is a half-migrated builtin Map k v scheme surface plus silent qualified-name/runtime fallback hazards.
TH: current support is recognizer simulation, not splice evaluation; makeLenses recognizer regressed on mkName-shaped names; expression splices silently desugar to 0.
Laziness/backend: STG interpreter forcing is mostly complete but interpreter GC roots fail at allocation scale; native forcing/header/GC paths are the active maturity gap.
GHC suite: published compatibility numbers must come from generated artifacts with timeouts; prior sweep-derived numbers were stale or incomplete.
